sentences.text: The documents do not state the EMI for a loan of INR 10,00,000 at an annual interest rate of 9% for 120 months.

The only EMI amounts stated are ₹21,696 for a Home loan (term loan), individual, non-business purpose with a sanctioned loan amount ₹25,00,000, loan term 240 months, and interest rate 8.5% p.a. floating, and the Loan Agreement also states 240 monthly instalments and ₹21,696 on the date of sanction.
